en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup> regarding the handshake of the Muslim for the Jew and the Christian.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From behind a (piece of) cloth. So if he was to shake your hand, so wash your hand’.
en.sarwar: 10. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from Wahab ibn Hafs from abu Basir from one of the two Imam (a.s.) who has said the following: “About shaking hands with a Jew or a Christian
he had said, ‘Shake hands with them from behind clothes and if you shook their hand without clothes then you must wash your hands.”’
